Elevator
We buy grain. We sell grain. Call before you dump.
Licensed warehouse
A country elevator that still takes the harvest.
Riegel Feed & Grain is listed by the Ohio Department of Agriculture as a grain warehouse in New Paris, Preble County. Buying and selling grain is one of the three things Nicole Wood named first when she described the business: custom grind, grain, and the rest of the store.
Bids move with the market. Moisture, test weight, and dump hours move with the weather. The only current number is the one you get on the phone.
Buy and sell grain
Licensed Ohio agricultural commodity handler / warehouse
Seed cleaning
Harvest receiving — call for hours
Call for a bid (937) 437-4221
At harvest
Load the truck, then call the mill.
Posted store hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. weekdays and 8:00 to 1:00 on Saturday. During corn and bean harvest those hours can stretch. Do not assume the pit is open after dark, or that we can take wet corn without a conversation first.
Before you leave the field
Phone for the day’s bid, moisture discounts, and whether we are receiving. A five-minute call beats a loaded truck in a closed lane.
At the scale
We are at 307 N Washington Street, at High Street, on the north side of New Paris. Watch for mill traffic and farm trucks.
After harvest
Grain we buy also becomes grain we grind. If you want your own corn back as feed, ask about custom mix off the same crop.
Seed cleaning
Ohio’s public listing for the mill includes seed cleaning. Call for what we can run and when the cleaner is available.
